name: Common pea (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Common pea (Pisum sativum) [Pulses] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170419 (Peas, green, raw) -- full proximate/sugar/amino-acid/fatty-acid/mineral/vitamin/carotenoid panel
Madurapperumage et al. 2025, Legume Science, doi:10.1002/leg3.70061 (organic acids in dry pea: citric, tartaric, malic+succinic group)
Rungruangmaitree & Jiraungkoorskul review, PMC10341148 (pea starch 39-46% dry seed)
FooDB FOOD00141 (compound presence for oligosaccharides, cyclitols, phytochemicals)
provenance.curation_notes: Curated on fresh green garden pea (USDA 170419). Dominant carbon/energy sources are sucrose (~5 g/100g) plus starch (~3 g/100g fresh; much higher in mature dry seed) with the raffinose-family oligosaccharides (raffinose/stachyose/verbascose) as characteristic but unquantified pea sugars; free glucose/fructose are minor. Organic acids (citric dominant, plus tartaric and a malic+succinic pool) added from dry-pea literature (dry-weight basis) as they were absent from the USDA panel. Protein-derived
curation_added: individual sugars with amounts (sucrose 4.99, fructose 0.39, maltose 0.17, glucose 0.12 g/100g)
organic acids with amounts (citric 27.58, tartaric 5.47 mg/100g; malic+succinic present as group)
full quantitative free/protein amino-acid profile (18 AAs)
fatty-acid profile with amounts (linoleic, palmitic, ALA, oleic, stearic)
carotenoids with amounts (lutein+zeaxanthin 2476, beta-carotene 449, alpha-carotene 21 ug/100g)
complete quantitative mineral and vitamin panel

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
